text: Teaching Objectives This program majoring in Western Economics. The program is designed to equip students with advanced skills in economic theoryand econometric. The emphasis is on development of students’ analytically skills, in particular their ability to identify key questions andto use theoretical and empirical tools to answer them. Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions andreview, visits to companies, and career consultation. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Economics by Shenyang University Future Career The graduates can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-tradecorporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises.
